name: stylex-scrolling-time-grid-view
title: Scrolling week and day views (StyleX)
description: Week, 3-day and day time grids that scroll sideways without end and come to rest on a day, as in Apple's Calendar on iPad: a sticky header, all-day row and hour gutter over day columns rendered a page either side with their events, keyboard paging, and drag, resize and create across the scroll.
